widget.title: Slowest Pipelines

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter pe.build_duration > 0
| aggregate {
    pe.projectidentifier as project,
    pe.pipelineidentifier as pipeline,
    count() as builds,
    round(avg(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 1) as avg_minutes,
    round(percentile(pe.build_duration, 90) / 60000.0, 1) as p90_minutes,
    round(max(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 1) as longest_minutes,
    round(sum(pe.build_duration) / 3600000.0, 2) as total_hours
  }
| group_by project, pipeline
| order_by avg_minutes desc
| limit 25

widget.title: Busiest Repositories & Branches

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter pe.moduleinfo_repository is not null and pe.moduleinfo_repository != 'NA' and pe.moduleinfo_repository != ''
| aggregate {
    pe.moduleinfo_repository as repository,
    pe.moduleinfo_branch_name as branch,
    count() as builds,
    round(avg(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 1) as avg_minutes,
    max(pe.startts) as last_build
  }
| group_by repository, branch
| order_by builds desc
| limit 25
